faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about EasyHealth, security and sharing your record.
faq.a1: EasyHealth is Benin's Shared Health Record. It brings together your history, treatments, allergies and exams in one secure place, and allows authorized healthcare professionals to access it with a simple temporary code.
faq.a2: Yes. Your data is encrypted (AES-256), hosted locally in Benin and every access is timestamped and traced in an audit log. EasyHealth is designed to be APDP and GDPR compliant.
faq.q3: How does temporary code sharing work?
faq.a3: You generate a temporary code from the app, single-use and time-limited (for example 1 hour). You decide who you give it to and for how long. Once expired, the code grants access to nothing.
faq.a4: Only the healthcare professionals you explicitly authorize, and only for the duration you set. All accesses appear in your audit log, which you can consult at any time.
faq.a5: Yes, the app is free for patients. Professionals and facilities have dedicated features depending on their role.
faq.q6: How does a professional get an account?
faq.a6: The professional signs up with their registration number and facility. Their account stays “pending” until verified by an administrator, who can then activate or reject it.
faq.q7: I forgot my password, what should I do?
faq.a7: On the login screen, click “Forgot password”. A secure reset link is sent to you by email. The link is valid for one hour.
faq.a8: No. Your health data is hosted on servers located in Benin, in accordance with personal data protection regulations.
faq.q9: Can I delete my account and my data?
faq.a9: Yes. In accordance with the GDPR and Beninese data protection law, you have a right of access, rectification and deletion. Contact us at the address indicated in the privacy policy.

guidePatient.title: Patient guide
guidePatient.intro: In a few steps, take control of your EasyHealth health record with peace of mind.
guidePatient.s1_p1: Click “Create my account” from the home page. Fill in your last name, first name, email and a secure password (8 characters minimum, with uppercase, lowercase, digit and special character).
guidePatient.s1_p2: Patients are activated immediately: you can log in right away.
guidePatient.s2_p1: In your dashboard, add your health information:
guidePatient.s2_li3: Blood type and useful vital signs;
guidePatient.s2_li4: Reports and exams if you wish.
guidePatient.s2_p2: The more complete your record, the safer the professional can treat you.
guidePatient.s3_p1: During a consultation, open the sharing feature from your record. A temporary code is generated, single-use and time-limited (for example 1 hour).
guidePatient.s3_p2: The doctor enters it in their app: they access your record for the time you allowed, then access closes automatically.
guidePatient.s4_p1: You decide who you give your code to and for how long. You can at any time:
guidePatient.s4_li1: Consult the audit log that lists every access (who, when, how long);
guidePatient.s4_li3: Never share your password, even with a caregiver.
guidePatient.s5_li1: Use a unique and strong password for EasyHealth;
guidePatient.s5_li2: Do not leave your code visible beyond the consultation;
guidePatient.s5_li3: Report any unusual access from the audit log;
guidePatient.s5_li4: If in doubt, contact us at contact@easyhealth.bj.

guidePro.title: Professional guide
guidePro.intro: Registration, verification and secure access to patient records with EasyHealth.
guidePro.s1_p1: Sign up by selecting your role (doctor, nurse, community agent or administrative). Enter your professional registration number and your facility — these fields are mandatory.
guidePro.s1_p2: Your account stays “pending” until verified by an administrator. You cannot log in until it is activated.
guidePro.s2_p1: Once verified, you access your professional space:
guidePro.s2_li1: List of patient records you are authorized to consult;
guidePro.s2_li2: History of your accesses and consultations;
guidePro.s2_li3: Data entry tools (vital signs, treatments, reports).
guidePro.s3_p1: During the consultation, ask the patient for their temporary code. Scan it with the EasyHealth Pro app: the record opens for the duration set by the patient (usually 1 hour).
guidePro.s3_p2: Once expired, access closes automatically and cannot be reopened without a new code.
guidePro.s4_p1: The unlocked record presents the information useful for care:
guidePro.s5_p1: Every access you make is timestamped and traced in the audit log, which can be consulted by the patient and by the administration. This is the platform's guarantee of transparency and accountability.
guidePro.s6_li1: Only enter official codes provided by the patient during consultation;
guidePro.s6_li2: Limit access duration to strictly what is needed;
guidePro.s6_li4: Comply with data protection law (APDP / GDPR).

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How EasyHealth collects, protects and uses your data, in accordance with APDP and GDPR.
privacy.s1_p1: The data controller is EasyHealth, publisher of the Shared Health Record platform in Benin. For any question regarding your data, you can contact us at contact@easyhealth.bj.
privacy.s2_p1: We only collect the data necessary for the service:
privacy.s2_li1: Identity: last name, first name, email, role (patient or healthcare professional);
privacy.s2_li3: Health data: history, treatments, allergies, exams and shared accesses, entered or generated as part of your record;
privacy.s2_li4: Professional data: registration number, facility and verification status for professionals;
privacy.s2_li5: Technical logs: connections and accesses, for security and traceability purposes.
privacy.s3_li2: Allow you to share your record with the professionals you authorize;
privacy.s3_li3: Verify the identity and qualifications of healthcare professionals;
privacy.s3_li4: Ensure the security, traceability and improvement of the service.
privacy.s4_p1: Processing is based on the performance of the contract binding you to EasyHealth, on your consent for sensitive health data, and on our legitimate interest in securing the platform. It is carried out in compliance with Benin's law n° 2017-07 of April 24, 2017 on the protection of personal data (APDP) and the GDPR.
privacy.s5_p1: Your health data is never sold. It is only shared with the healthcare professionals you explicitly authorize, via a temporary, single-use code. Each sharing is recorded as an entry in the audit log, which you can consult.
privacy.s5_p2: Certain technical data may be entrusted to subcontractors (hosting, email sending) bound by strict confidentiality obligations.
privacy.s6_p1: Your data is hosted on servers located in Benin. It is encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (HTTPS/TLS). Access is protected by authentication, role-based access control (RBAC) and logging of all accesses.
privacy.s7_p1: Your data is kept for the duration of your account, then deleted or anonymized according to the periods provided by applicable regulations, unless a legal retention obligation applies.
privacy.s8_p1: In accordance with Beninese data protection law and the GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacy.s8_li1: Right of access, rectification and update of your data;
privacy.s8_li2: Right to erasure (“right to be forgotten”);
privacy.s8_li3: Right to restriction and objection to processing;
privacy.s8_p2: To exercise these rights, write to us at contact@easyhealth.bj. You may also file a complaint with the APDP (Personal Data Protection Authority).
privacy.s9_p1: EasyHealth uses cookies that are strictly necessary for session operation and security (authentication, language preference). No advertising tracking cookie is placed without your consent.
